name: Perfect Nightmare: Overkill
source:
Uhh, it's basically about an underground organization in the underworld that accepts all kinds of requests, as long as they're completely ridiculous. (Because videogame-esque quests are just too boring, right?) Everything's all fine and dandy, until one day someone asks them to destroy the earth...

[From [url=http://lemmasoft.renai.us/forums/viewtopic.php?f=16&t=6275&st=0&sk=t&sd=a]lemmasoft forums[/url]]
translation:
呃，简单来说，这是一个地下世界组织的故事。只要委托内容荒唐到极点，他们什么要求都会接受。（毕竟，像电子游戏任务那样的委托实在太无聊了，对吧？）一切原本都很顺利，直到某天，有人要求他们毁灭地球…

[摘自[url=http://lemmasoft.renai.us/forums/viewtopic.php?f=16&t=6275&st=0&sk=t&sd=a]Lemmasoft论坛[/url]]
